# CoPackagedOptics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Integration of optical engines directly with switch or compute packages to reduce electrical-optical conversion distances and power. Reduces latency and energy overhead in TCC topologies, making optical interconnect viable for high-bandwidth neuromorphic data flows.
